$comment: One entry per desktop_* RemoteCommand: the studio_action (or frame) a client on the Studio wire uses instead. Read by server/src/protocol/__tests__/phone-command-parity.test.ts and by the iOS mapper's tests. 'value' is studio_action_result.value; 'events' means the outcome arrives on the event stream (studio:thin-* channels or ion:normalized-event), not as a value.

desktop_sync.result: studio_welcome.snapshot.thin is the first snapshot; a later resync is a studio_snapshot_request frame answered by studio_snapshot

desktop_request_resend.result: never synthesized: the Studio wire has no sequence numbers to resend; a gap is healed by a full resync

desktop_unpair.result: none; the server then closes the connection with studio_close{revoked}, and the client forgets the server

desktop_report_mobile_auth.transport: the credential's relayIdentity, set when the phone joins the relay

desktop_auth.args: token -> studio_hello bearer credential; a refresh is a studio_reauth frame

desktop_load_conversation.args: {tabId, before, pageSize, held} -> studio_body_request{tabId, before?, limit: pageSize, held?: {epoch, rev}}
desktop_load_conversation.result: a transcript page: studio_body{rows, hasMore, cursor, before, streamId, epoch, rev, total, startIndex}; a newest page subscribes the connection to the stream's desktop_transcript_patch events; when held is the stream's current revision the reply is studio_body{rows: [], unchanged: true, streamId, epoch, rev, total} and the client keeps its rows

desktop_engine_add_instance.transport: dropped: the server ignores this command (one instance per conversation), so the client stops sending it

desktop_engine_remove_instance.transport: dropped: the server ignores this command (one instance per conversation), so the client stops sending it

desktop_engine_select_instance.transport: dropped: the server ignores this command (one instance per conversation), so the client stops sending it

desktop_engine_move_instance.transport: dropped: the server ignores this command (one instance per conversation), so the client stops sending it

desktop_create_tab.args: [{workingDirectory, profileId, useWorktree, sourceBranch, ephemeralWorktree, rememberWorktreeChoice, clientCmdId}] (extensions is not sent; the profile names them)
desktop_create_tab.result: value is {tabId}, null when the create failed; the server sends desktop_tab_created{tab, clientCmdId} as an event, so no client synthesizes it

desktop_create_terminal_tab.result: value is {tabId}; desktop_tab_created and desktop_terminal_instance_added both arrive as events

desktop_close_tab.result: value.closed true -> desktop_tab_closed{tabId}; false -> nothing (the row stays; value says what is running)

desktop_prompt.args: [{tabId, text, attachments, clientMsgId, instanceId, implementationPhase, traceparent}] (origin is not sent; traceparent also rides the frame's outer envelope)
desktop_prompt.result: desktop_prompt_result{tabId, clientMsgId: value.clientMsgId, status: value.accepted ? 'accepted' : 'rejected', error: value.reason}; the user-turn echo arrives on studio:user-message-echo

desktop_stop_background_task.result: desktop_background_task_stop_result{requestId (the client's own), taskId, status: value.status ?? (value.ok ? 'stopped' : 'failed'), error: value.error}

desktop_system_metrics_watch.result: value: {latest, watching}; samples then arrive as desktop_system_metrics on studio:thin-event

desktop_request_transcript.args: [{tabId, offset, length}] paged until value.hasMore is false (requestId stays client-side)

desktop_fork_from_message.result: desktop_input_prefill{tabId: value.tabId, text: value.pendingInput, switchTo: true}; value null = fork refused

desktop_engine_rewind.result: value.ok false -> desktop_engine_rewind_result{tabId, instanceId, status: 'rejected', error: value.error}; true with pendingInput -> desktop_input_prefill{tabId, instanceId, text: value.pendingInput}

desktop_load_dispatch_transcript.args: {tabId, conversationId, dispatchId, before, pageSize, held} -> studio_body_request{tabId, conversationId, dispatchId, before?, limit: pageSize, held?: {epoch, rev}}
desktop_load_dispatch_transcript.result: a dispatched agent's transcript page: studio_body{conversationId, dispatchId, rows, streamId, epoch, rev, total, startIndex, ...}; a newest page subscribes the connection to that dispatch stream's desktop_transcript_patch events; when held is the stream's current revision the reply is studio_body{rows: [], unchanged: true, ...} and the client keeps its rows

desktop_request_agent_state.result: desktop_agent_state{tabId, instanceId, agents} from the same fields of value

desktop_load_attachments.result: desktop_tab_attachments{tabId, attachments} from the same fields of value

desktop_switch_branch.result: desktop_branch_switch_result{tabId, error?}; the new path arrives as a transcript replace

desktop_request_plan_content.result: desktop_plan_content{tabId, questionId, planFilePath, offset, content, totalBytes, hasMore} from the same fields of value

desktop_report_focus.args: [tabId, null, {interceptEnabled}], then markTabRead [tabId] when tabId is not null

desktop_diagnostic_logs_response.args: [{lines: logs, nextSeq, pairingId, withheldUnstamped, withheldOtherPairing}], sent on the client's own cadence; sinceSeq for the next batch is value.nextSeq

desktop_terminal_add_instance.result: value is the new instance id; the client then reads terminal.paneSnapshot [{tabId}] and synthesizes desktop_terminal_snapshot from it, which names every instance and the active one

desktop_run_quick_tool.result: none from the run; the client then reads terminal.paneSnapshot [{tabId}] and synthesizes desktop_terminal_snapshot from it, which names the tool's terminal as the active one

desktop_terminal_remove_instance.result: desktop_terminal_instance_removed{tabId, instanceId} once the action returns

desktop_request_terminal_snapshot.result: desktop_terminal_snapshot{tabId, instances, activeInstanceId, buffers} from the same fields of value; null = no such tab

desktop_git_branches.result: desktop_git_branches_response{directory, branches, current, error} from the same fields of value

desktop_git_stage.result: desktop_git_stage_result{directory, ok, error} from value. Then the client re-reads git.changes [{directory}] to synthesize the refresh the old wire pushed.

desktop_git_unstage.result: desktop_git_unstage_result{directory, ok, error} from value. Then the client re-reads git.changes [{directory}] to synthesize the refresh the old wire pushed.

desktop_git_commit.result: desktop_git_commit_result{directory, ok, error} from value; a bench refusal arrives as ok false with its reason. Then the client re-reads git.changes [{directory}] and git.graph to synthesize the refresh the old wire pushed.

desktop_git_discard.result: no result event on the old wire. Then the client re-reads git.changes [{directory}] to synthesize the refresh the old wire pushed.

desktop_git_fetch.result: no result event on the old wire; value is {ok, error}. Then the client re-reads git.changes [{directory}] and git.graph to synthesize the refresh the old wire pushed.

desktop_git_pull.result: no result event on the old wire; value is {ok, error}, and a bench refusal arrives as ok false with its reason. Then the client re-reads git.changes [{directory}] and git.graph to synthesize the refresh the old wire pushed.

desktop_git_push.result: no result event on the old wire; value is {ok, error}, and a bench refusal arrives as ok false with its reason. Then the client re-reads git.graph [{directory, withLayout: true}].

desktop_fs_rename.result: desktop_fs_rename_result{oldPath, newPath, ok, error} from value

desktop_upload_attachment.result: desktop_upload_attachment_result{id, name, path, contentHash, correlationId} from value; value null -> error 'Failed to save uploaded file'

desktop_request_theme_asset.result: desktop_theme_asset_content{themeId, slot, ok: value !== null, sha256, dataUrl}

desktop_set_desktop_setting.result: studio:thin-settings carries the applied value; value.ok false (code, message) means the client keeps what it had

desktop_set_remote_display.result: desktop_remote_display{customName, customIcon, updatedAt} from value (the stored value when the edit lost to a newer one)

desktop_questions_patch.result: ion:questions-state; value {actionId, accepted, error} rolls back a stale revision

desktop_questions_action.result: ion:questions-state; value {actionId, accepted, error} rolls back a stale revision

desktop_questions_refresh.result: desktop_questions_state from value, filtered to tabId client-side

desktop_worktree_open_conversation.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'open', ok: true, tabId: value; an action error -> ok false, error}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_sync.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'sync', ok, error, hasConflicts, refusedDirty from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_sync_all.result: events (desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'sync_all'} and the refreshed state are published by the verb)

desktop_worktree_land_and_retire.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'land_and_retire', ok, error, hasConflicts, refusedDirty, warning, prunedBenchPaths from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_open_conversation.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'open', ok: value !== null, tabId: value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_open_terminal.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'open', ok: value !== null, tabId: value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_assemble.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'assemble', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_update_member.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'update', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_update_all.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'update_all', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_set_stage.result: studio:thin-worktrees; an action error -> desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'update', ok: false, error}

desktop_worktree_retire_landed.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'retire', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_create.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'create', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_convert_conversation.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'convert', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_rename.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'rename', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_reprovision.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'reprovision', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_retire.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'retire', ok, error, recoveryRef, prunedBenchPaths from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_conflict_assist.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'conflict_assist', ok: true, tabId: value; an action error -> ok false, error}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_conflict_assist.args: [repoPath, sourceBranch], then openConflictAssist [value] when value (the bench path) is not null
desktop_bench_conflict_assist.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'conflict_assist', ok: true, tabId: the second value; a null bench path -> ok false}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_recover_conflict.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'recover_conflict', ok: value !== null}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_analyse_verification.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'analyse_verification', ok: true, tabId: value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_discard_member_recordings.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'discard_recordings', ok, error from value}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_bench_discard_all_recordings.args: [benchPath] where benchPath is the RemoteBench.benchPath for sourceBranch, then refreshBench [repoPath]
desktop_bench_discard_all_recordings.result: desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'discard_recordings', ok: true; an action error -> ok false, error}; refreshed state arrives on studio:thin-worktrees

desktop_worktree_pipeline_start.result: studio:thin-worktrees pipeline; an action error -> desktop_worktree_op_result{operation: 'pipeline_start', ok: false, error}

desktop_worktree_pipeline_confirm_ai.args: [] (the server holds one pipeline; repoPath is not sent)
